summary.text: Mary Dye is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 9-Position 1, which she has represented since May 8, 2015, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She succeeded Susan Fagan (R) and advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary, with no other candidate listed for the November ballot.
